criteria.requirement: Implement DefaultConfigFileParser(*, duplicates="last") with last/warn/error for exact case-sensitive keys within one parsed stream. Keep the old last-value policy by default. Warn/error diagnostics identify the source and first/current 1-based physical lines without values. Blank/comment lines count; repeated lists are whole-value replacement. Parsing separate streams never shares duplicate state; normal cross-file precedence and CLI override stay unchanged. Reject unknown policies and preserve all existing syntax and serialization.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
